about: E03 (ffw-q2p) host-side cases.  Expected values are written independently of tests/e03/abi.py.  REAL = the committed transcripts and receipt of central QEMU run 1412ac47 (toolchain/results/runs/1412ac47120d4e5b865f9de6e05f50fe/), read unmodified; PLANTED = one changed or removed line in a real transcript (each mutation must apply and must change the text, so a planted case cannot pass vacuously); SYNTHETIC = a line added, or an inline transcript, because no real source exists; BLOCKED = required, unverifiable now.  The E03-BUILD-*, PROBE-*, RT-*, NET-* and SEED-* cases start from the real run: the earlier SYNTHETIC baseline of twenty added lines was retired when the run supplied them.  The two real baselines differ in exactly one probe: MIPS GETRANDOM is UNSEEDED (rc=-11, so MIPS is DEGRADED) and PPC GETRANDOM is PASS (rc=16).  validate_doc enforces the labelling: a REAL title needs empty mutations and any added line needs SYNTHETIC in the title.  The probes are freestanding raw-syscall PID-1 code on Debian 4.19/4.9 kernels: not musl/std, not a stock Sonos kernel, not the audio driver.  (An earlier run, f0a91e7b, built identical binaries with the same probe lines, but its receipt listed 10 source digests, not 12, so no case reads it.)  Still blocked: retained-audio-driver readiness (E03-BLK-006).

The committed central run 1412ac47 is pinned by digest, and its receipt, raw captures and transcripts agree: log, stdout and stderr bytes, kernel, build identity, all 12 source digests, capability lists and every probe line
The runner refuses wrong expectations, vacuous mutations, malformed documents and miscounted exits
Every invariant names existing cases, every case covers an invariant, inapplicability is explained

Retained-audio-driver readiness, underrun and wake behavior
cases.reason: CHARDEV_POLL is generic VFS poll on /dev/zero and /dev/null: readiness, underrun and wake behavior of the retained audio driver are NOT probed and not claimed, and need the E04 driver in an exact-version guest. The real guests also do not show rename durability on the device's own storage: FS_RENAME renames a pair of files on the guest's root filesystem and reads them back
cases.owner: E04 for the audio driver; a stock-kernel guest and the device's storage for durability

invariants.text: Syscall result to errno mapping, per ABI
EINTR and EAGAIN are transient and never mean unsupported
Short I/O is a normal result; a full or zero count is not a short write
Time-width boundaries (tv_nsec, 32-bit counters)
Overflow of probe integers
Alignment boundaries (allocator, atomics operand)
invariants.note: allocator, atomic-width and memory-peak probes are now REAL (E03-CLASS-001/002, planted variants in E03-RT-*). MEM_PEAK reads the probe process's own VmPeak/VmHWM (64 kB MIPS, 60 kB PPC): it is not a budget for the firmware. Not probed: an atomic operand's misalignment behavior and widths beyond the recorded 32 bits. newc archive alignment is covered elsewhere (scripts/test/test_support/newc_case.py)

invariants.note: the process-group capture, timeout and kill of the guest are toolchain/src/run-qemu-verification.py::capture_guest (root, E07); this host-side classifier only reads a finished transcript. A cancelled or timed-out run leaves a truncated transcript, which E03-CLASS-030 and E03-CLASS-031 classify as an unavailable guest.

Socket I/O semantics, device readiness, reactor wakeup and filesystem durability
invariants.note: socket data path, reactor wakeup, character-device poll and rename are REAL on the Debian harness guests (E03-CLASS-001/002); readiness of the retained audio driver is not probed (E03-BLK-006) and FS_RENAME says nothing about the device's own storage

invariants.text: The probe's build identity (target triple, compiler, linker flavor, libc) is recorded, self-consistent with the profile, and gates the verdict without altering any probe's result

An optional capability with a declared fallback degrades the verdict only while the fallback is supported; an exact -ENOSYS is a classified absence in the guest's own ABI numbering; anything else is ambiguous

Runtime behaviors the executor cannot run without (signal delivery, repeated timer interrupts, EINTR, allocator, filesystem rename, atomic width) are REQUIRED: a missing or ambiguous result is red; threads, TLS and memory peak are optional with no fallback and only degrade
A missing probe line from a transcript whose guest carries the probes is red (the probe did not run); an exact -ENOSYS is degraded; the two are never filed together
A case never presents a modified or added transcript as live evidence: REAL means unmodified, every added line says SYNTHETIC

A getrandom whose entropy pool is not yet seeded at PID-1 boot is reported UNSEEDED: present, never supported, never absent, never green, and the /dev/urandom fallback does not rescue it because it reads the same pool
